sections.h: How we plan a private flight to or from Milan
p: Tell us where you are flying from or to, when, and how many people are travelling. We compare the airports around Milan for your times and your aircraft, find aircraft from licensed operators, check each operator before you see a quote, and name the operator in your quote and agreement. Any aircraft, any route, upon availability.

Airport rules change at short notice. The operator and its handling agent confirm the current rules for your flight before departure; every fact on this page shows its source and the date we checked it.
